scripts.build:shared: cd shared && npm install && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/tsup && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && cd storefront && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:back-office: npm run build:shared && cd back-office && npm install && npm run build
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "shared,backend,storefront,back-office,ai-service" -c "gray,blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm run watch --prefix shared" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix storefront" "npm run dev --prefix back-office" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service"
